reason: Plain write of analysisSlot.index at owner.go:82 on every permit Acquire races with the plain read at http.go:33 from a request goroutine that is not joined. Reproduced independently with a woven net/http server under default config (a handler with a fire-and-forget r.URL.Query() goroutine) and through the internal API on Go 1.26.6 and 1.27.0. It only affects -race builds (same value, no wrong result), but it is a data race in production code per the brief's scale. The ReadAllBytes/CloneReaderBytes paths are mostly masked by the sourceMu happens-before edge and race only in a narrow window. Fix: initialize index once in NewManager (verified).
